long_biography.plain_text:
Namdar Realty Group's investment model turns unwanted commercial properties into income-producing assets. Igal Namdar and property partner Elliot Nassim expanded from local retail to struggling regional malls, paying deeply discounted prices when established owners withdrew. Namdar oversees finance and property management while Nassim concentrates on leasing, a division that lets the private firms evaluate and close acquisitions quickly.

Rather than assuming every site needs wholesale redevelopment, Namdar's method begins with the price, existing tenants and the cash flow that affordable rents can preserve. The group has carried the same bargain-focused discipline beyond shopping centres into distressed office properties, keeping commercial real estate at the centre of his business. Namdar continues to lead the company he founded.
